select a.id AS "id", a.plan_id AS "planId", a.plan_name AS "planName", a.inspection_type AS "inspectionType", a.inspector_id AS "inspectorId", a.start_time AS "startTime", a.end_time AS "endTime", a.attachment_path AS "attachmentPath", a.inspection_list_status AS "inspectionListStatus", a.create_by AS "createBy", a.create_date AS "createDate", a.update_by AS "updateBy", a.update_date AS "updateDate", a.remarks AS "remarks", a.status AS "status", b.name AS "inspector", plan.plan_code AS "planCode" from swm_inspection_list a left join swm_person b on a.inspector_id = b.id left join swm_inspection_plan plan on plan.id = a.plan_id where a.status = '0' order by a.start_time desc limit #{limit}
